knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Structural repair and subfloor work are excluded from the course and usually from the job. Sanding and finishing are within an approved scope.
The course is training only. It does not grant a licence, certificate or authority, and the lesson states this.
An unclear scope is confirmed in writing before work starts, and items outside it are referred.
A variation records approval for any change to the agreed scope before work continues.
Unassessed material that may contain asbestos requires a stop and a referral. A gap or an absent client does not, on its own, require the same stop.

practicalCriteria: Candidate reads the written scope and identifies at least one included and one excluded item from it.
Candidate identifies a structural or subfloor concern on a site walk and refers it without performing the work.
Candidate states the licence and notification position that applies to the job's state or territory, or names the check to make.
Candidate records the scope confirmation and a variation, with written approval, before any machine is started.
passRule: Knowledge checks: at least 80% correct (4 of 5). Practical sign-off is separate. A knowledge pass does not establish practical competence, and the practical criteria must be observed and recorded by an assessor.
evidenceRequired: Signed or agreed scope with included and excluded items
Referral record for the structural concern
stopWorkCriteria: Work starts without a confirmed written scope
Structural or subfloor work is performed under this course
A machine is used on a job whose licence position is unknown and not recorded
